s.note: cabin 12 at the mountain lodge where the tape was found
s.how: Flake 150g hot-smoked trout onto a wooden board. Add crackers, 200g sharp cheddar, a sliced apple and pickled onions, the way a mountain lodge would set it out.

Slice 500g small cucumbers thin and pack into a jar with dill, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over 250ml hot white vinegar boiled with 250ml water, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp salt. Refrigerate seven days before eating.

m.note: the ferry to the island with the horse farm
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp soy and brush over 4 salmon fillets. Roast at 220C for 8 minutes. Cook 250g wild rice. Char 2 bunches broccolini in a hot pan.

w.note: the well at the bottom of everything
w.how: Warm 300ml cream and 200ml milk, pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Whisk 4 yolks with 60g sugar and combine. Pour into 4 deep cups and bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes. Chill and pipe a ring of cream.

d.note: cabin 12 at the Shelter Mountain Inn
d.how: Put 1 tbsp honey, the juice of a quarter lemon and 40ml whisky in each of 4 mugs. Top with 150ml boiling water, stir and add a cinnamon stick.
